conversation.Statement: Hello, this is Sarah from Amazon Security. I'm calling regarding a recent activity on your Amazon account. Can I please confirm that I'm speaking with Mrs. Taylor?
Yes, this is Mrs. Taylor. Is there a problem with my account?

Thank you, Mrs. Taylor. We detected an attempt to purchase a PlayStation 5 using your Amazon account earlier today. For your protection, we have temporarily placed your account under review. Have you or anyone in your household tried to make this purchase?
Oh no! My son sometimes uses my Amazon, but I didn't approve any PlayStation purchase.
I understand, and I'm here to help. These things happen. To help us verify your identity and secure your account, could you please confirm the phone number associated with your Amazon profile?

Thank you for confirming. For your peace of mind, I want to assure you that Amazon takes unauthorized activity very seriously. Now, to ensure no further action is taken on your account, can you please provide your full name as it appears on your Amazon profile?
It's Linda Taylor.

Thank you, Linda. I'm going to walk you through the process to reverse this order and prevent a permanent lock on your account. Before we proceed, do you currently have access to your computer or smart device?
Yes, I'm at my laptop right now.
Perfect. To cancel the unauthorized purchase and confirm your identity, I'll need you to open your browser and go to a secure Amazon verification website. Please type in: verify-amazon-help.com.
Okay, I'm typing that in now. It says 'Amazon Security Verification'.
Great. You should see a prompt to enter your Amazon account email. Please enter it so we can generate a confirmation code.
Alright, I entered my email.
Thank you. Now, a six-digit code will be sent to your phone. Please read that code to me so I can verify your identity.
Let me check... Okay, it's 836209.

Excellent. Thank you for your cooperation, Linda. For your security, your account is now being re-verified. However, I must inform you there is a pending charge of $599 for the PlayStation 5. If we do not process a temporary security hold, your account will be locked and the order may ship.
Wait, do I have to pay for something I didn't order?

No, not at all. This is only a refundable security hold to prove the payment method is in your control and to cancel the unauthorized purchase. Once we confirm this, your funds will be returned immediately.
I'm not sure I understand. What do I have to do?

I'll guide you step by step. For this security procedure, Amazon requires the temporary hold to be processed via Amazon Gift Cards. This is the safest and fastest method, and you'll receive a full refund to your card as soon as the process is complete.
So I have to buy gift cards? Can't you just cancel the order?

I understand your concern, Linda. Unfortunately, because the purchase originated from your account, our policy requires confirmation of identity through the security hold. It's a temporary measure to protect you, and the funds will be credited back right after verification.
Alright, how much do I need in gift cards?
Please purchase Amazon Gift Cards totaling $600 from a local retailer or online. Once you have them, I'll show you how to enter the codes into the secure verification portal.
Okay... I'll go to the store and get them now. Should I call back when I have the cards?
You can stay on the line, or if you prefer, I can hold. It's important we resolve this quickly so your account isn't locked. Once you return, let me know and I'll walk you through the next steps.
Alright, I'll be back in about 15 minutes.
Thank you, Linda. I'll be here when you return. Please remember, this is a standard Amazon security protocol and your cooperation is appreciated.
I'm back. I have the gift cards now.
Perfect. Now, please click the 'Enter Gift Card Code' button on the website you opened earlier. Read the numbers from each card to me so I can submit them securely.
The first code is 9XY7-32QP-LKZ5-RT8D.
Thank you. Please continue with the next codes until you've entered all $600 worth.
Okay, the second one is 4FQ3-KL8D-22R7-PX9M, and the third is 8LRT-PQ71-9JZK-D2W8.
Thank you, Linda. I've submitted the codes for processing. You should receive a refund confirmation email within the next 30 minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with while we wait?
No, I just hope this takes care of it. Thank you for your help.
You're most welcome. Your patience and cooperation have helped secure your account. If you have any questions, you can reach us at this number. Have a wonderful day, Linda.
